d:
A tall anthropomorphic wolf with sleek silver gray fur and a sharp, refined facial structure. Intelligent amber eyes with a composed, loyal expression. Apparent age of a mature adult with a slender, athletic build. Wears a formal black butler's tuxedo with a white dress shirt and a crisp white cravat. Signature details include long wolf ears, a long bushy silver tail, and four toes with sharp claws on each foot.
BODY COLOR: silver gray
